basics.name: Ananda Dwi Rahmawati
basics.label: Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer with 6+ years of experience architecting, automating, and optimizing public cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) for mission-critical environments. Proven track record in cost optimization, security, compliance, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure cloud platforms. Recognized as AWS Container Hero and Google Developer Expert. Expert in IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins), and cloud-native architectures. Passionate about documentation, process improvement, and mentoring.
